_about: Indications for run-up study rows whose /fda-decision page carries no Indication line, each read from a primary source for THAT FDA action (FDA letter, label or FDA page, or the sponsor's own release or SEC filing) on 2026-11-18. Until then extend_runup_study.py copied the ticker's first dataset row's indication onto new rows (Pfizer's Hympavzi read 'Dermatomyositis'). curate_runup_study.py applies an entry only while its drug matches the row's drug; a page without an Indication line and without an entry here leaves the row's indication blank. tests/test_runup_study_current.py check 6 enforces it. Add an entry only from a primary source you read.
